arabic text: ZAINAB NE DI SADA, KYA TUM MERE HUSSAIN HO\nKAISE PADE HAI JISM KE, TUKDE JUDA JUDA
english translation text: Removing stones from the body, Zainab cried: Are you my Hussain?\nWhy does your body lie in pieces, separated from one another?

arabic text:
HAYE HAYE MERE GHAREEB KA
KYA HAAL KAR DIYA
GHODO'N SE LASHA DASHT MEIN
PAMAAL KAR DIYA
PEHCHANU KIS TARAH SE, BADAN SE HAI SAR JUDA
english translation text:
Alas, what have they done to
my lonely brother? They trampled his
body beneath horses in the desert.
How can I recognise you when
your head is separated from your body?

arabic text:
PEHCHAN LUN GI MAI TUMHE
AWAAZ MUJH KO DO
DAM TODTE JO DEKHA HAI
KADYAL JAWAAN KO
ANKHON MAI AB BEHEN KI, UJALA NAHI RAHA
english translation text:
I will recognise you if
you call out to me. I
watched the young warrior breathe
his last. There is no light
left within your sister's eyes.

arabic text:
PEHCHANNA TUMHARE LIYE
BHI KATHAN HOWA
DEKHA HAI PEHLI BAAR JO
ZAINAB KO BERIDA
AATI HAI SHARM JALD, BATA DO MUJHE ZARA
english translation text:
Even recognising me has become
difficult for you, for the
first time you have seen
Zainab without a veil.
I feel ashamed—tell me quickly.

arabic text:
KARTA RAHA HAI ZIBHA KI
KOSHISH KAHA'N KAHA'N
KHANJAR PE HAI KATI HUI
GARDAN PE BHI NISHA'N
KAATA HAI KIS TARAH SE
SITAMGAAR NE GALAA
english translation text:
At how many places
did he try to slaughter
you? There are marks
upon the dagger and your
severed throat. How did
the oppressor cut your neck?

arabic text:
KYA LE GAYE HAI LOOT KE
SAB KUCH YE ASHQIYA'N
TAN PAR BACHA HAI MAA KA YE
KURTA SILA HUA
NIKLE THE JAB KHAYAM SE
YE HAAL TO NA THA
english translation text:
What have these tyrants
taken after plundering everything?
Only the shirt Mother
stitched remains upon your body.
You did not leave
the tents in this condition.

arabic text:
HAI SATH US KE MAA
KYA AB TUMHARE PAAS HAI
MASOOM BE ZUBA'N
NANHA SA LASHA KIS KA YE
SEENE PE HAI RAKHA
english translation text:
Mother is beside him.
Is the innocent speechless
infant with you now?
Whose tiny body rests
upon your chest?

arabic text:
DEKHO BANDHI HAI HATHO'N MEIN
MERE BHI RASSIYA
AB AUR LO BEHEN KI NA
GHURBAT KA IMTEHA'N
KUCH TO JAWAB DO MUJHE
SUGHRA KA WASTA
english translation text:
Look, ropes are tied
around my hands too.
Do not test your
sister's loneliness any further.
Give me some reply,
for Sughra's sake.

arabic text:
WOH BHI TUMHARE TARHA SE
ZAKHMI NA HO KAHI'N
DIL KO MERE YE LAGTA HAI
MAUJOOD HAI YAHI'N
AATI HAI MAA KE RONE KI
NAZDEEK SE SADA
english translation text:
Perhaps she too is
wounded like you. My
heart tells me she
is present nearby. I
can hear Mother's weeping
from close by.

arabic text:
ZAINAB PUKARI MIR TAKALLUM BASAD MALAAL
KYA MARTE WAQT BHI MERE
PARDE KA THA KHAYAL
HAI MUTHIYO'N MEIN KIS LIYE
YEH KHAAK E KARBALA
english translation text:
O Mir Taqallum, Zainab cried
in immense grief: even while dying,
were you thinking of my
veil? Why is the dust of
Karbala clenched within your fists?
